decks.content_note: Meanings follow the Rider-Waite-Smith tradition. Turkish is the production locale; English carries canonical names, keywords and a one-line meaning. Azerbaijani is not authored yet.

24 Elder Futhark runes in the traditional three aettir. A rune whose glyph is vertically symmetrical cannot be drawn reversed and therefore carries no reversed meaning - inventing one would be inventing tradition. The blank 'Odin' rune is a 20th-century addition, kept out of the canonical 24 and dealt only when enabled.

All 65 meanings are PRODUCT-DEFINED, not traditional. Unlike tarot (Rider-Waite-Smith) or the Elder Futhark (the rune poems), this deck has no single documented tradition that could be verified. Some cards have transparent Turkish names whose sense follows from the word; others are proper names whose Katina-specific meaning could not be confirmed from any source. The interpretation prompt is told to present these as this deck's stated meanings, never as inherited tradition. The card list itself comes from the audited production assets. Katina has no reversal tradition, so every card is upright.
